[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **One page in the application-level nav.** It takes the official `sidebar.panellist` seat with
`or"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"der: 5` — between the shipped **Plugins** row (0) and the shipped **Schedule** row (10) — plus
the w"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"hole page in the layout's `main` keyed slot. Both seats are registered through the
framework's `slot"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"s` service, the same extension point the shipped pages use.
- **All six skill-root kinds, not just o"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ne.** DSH resolves skills from `project-dsh`,
`project-agents`, `custom`, `user-dsh`, `user-agents`,"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" and `bundled`. Scanning only
`~/.dsh/skills` under-reports what a session can actually see.
- **It "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"answers "why is this skill not there?"** A malformed frontmatter block makes the runtime
drop a skil"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"l silently. The cockpit reports the concrete reason (`dropped:no-frontmatter`,
`dropped:unclosed`, `"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"dropped:bad-yaml`, `dropped:missing-fields`, `dropped:bad-name`), plus a
missing root, a shadowed en"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"try, or an explicit error — instead of showing nothing.
- **It also answers "is anything using this "},{"id":"p11s11","text":"skill?"** The session logs record every skill
invocation as a `tool-call` block (`name: "skill"`, ar"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"gument `arguments.name`), and the cockpit
reads them and counts. 0.6.9 fixed a detector that only re"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"cognised an older
`skill-invocation` shape — which made every count read zero; re-scanning 113 exist"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"ing sessions
surfaced real usage (e.g. `ui-design` ×8, `git-workflow` ×4).
Counts live in `<dshHome>"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"/dsh-skill-cockpit/usage.json` (skill names, counts, timestamps only —
never message text).
- **"Loa"},{"id":"p11s16","text":"ds, but earns nothing" checks.** Four kinds of technically-valid skill that a model will
still never"},{"id":"p11s17","text":" pick: `shadowed` (a duplicate name loses to a higher-priority root),
`short-description` (too short"},{"id":"p11s18","text":" to choose between), `dir-name-mismatch` (bundle folder contradicts
the frontmatter name), `empty-bo"},{"id":"p11s19","text":"dy` (a heuristic, measured in file bytes and labelled as such).
- **Toggling = renaming the entry fi"},{"id":"p11s20","text":"le only.** Enable/disable flips `SKILL.md` ⇄
`SKILL.md.disabled`. There is no sidecar state file, so"},{"id":"p11s21","text":" there is exactly one source of truth:
the filename. **Project-level skill roots are always read-onl"},{"id":"p11s22","text":"ctly one source of truth:
the filename. **Project-level skill roots are always read-only.**
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Security: two refusals, both enforced by the host half"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The panel is a local web surface, so the routes do not trust their caller. Two refusals are part
of "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"the contract, and each one has a negative test in the suite:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **`/body` is whitelist-only.** It answers **only** for entry files that the `/skills` report
liste"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"d; any other path — an arbitrary file, the plugin's own data file, a path that merely
exists — is re"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"fused with **403** and no content, so the route cannot be turned into a file
reader. (Before 0.3.1 i"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"t read any path it was given; found by review, not by an incident.)
- **`/toggle` only ever writes i"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"nside the two user-level write roots.** The target must sit inside
`~/.dsh/skills` or `~/.agents/ski"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"lls`; **project-level roots are read-only even when the report
lists the file**, because a path deri"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ved from a session's `cwd` must never become a write."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"`cwd` is **optional** on both routes (0.3.2): this panel is also a standalone page that has no
sessi"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"on at all. Without it the report simply has no project-level roots, so those entries are
refused whi"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"le every user-level one still works — and a `cwd` that does not resolve is ignored
rather than trust"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ed, so it cannot be used to slip past the write-root gate."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Requests carrying a foreign `Origin` are refused with 403."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Why some skills cannot be disabled"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"A skill can reach a session down two different roads, and only one of them ends at a file:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **File-backed** (`user-dsh`, `user-agents`, `custom`, project roots, a bundled directory): the
ent"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ry is a real `SKILL.md` or `x.md`, so the cockpit can park it by renaming the entry file.
- **Provid"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"er-backed**: DSH's contract is `ctx.skills.registerProvider(() => provider)` — additive by
design. A"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" provider contributes its own `list()`; there is **no hook to wrap, filter or exclude
another provid"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"er's output**. Nothing this panel does can make such a skill disappear."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"That asymmetry is not a missing feature, it is the host API's shape, so the panel states it
plainly:"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" a provider-supplied row renders `本面板无法禁用（属 … provider）` where the switch would
otherwise sit. A swi"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"tch that silently did nothing would be worse than no switch."}],"truncated":true}
